findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - Neon streams a progress message before requesting a tool, and the refused call ends the turn without a review.
Done when: An Antigravity review whose tool call is refused either returns Neon's written review or stops with a message that names the refused step, never "empty output".
The handler collects all agent message chunks at src/forge/antigravity.py:400, so progress text makes this condition treat the turn as answered. Autoreview then reports non-JSON output without naming the refused step; its parser is at tests/fixtures/autoreview-ce14dcca/scripts/autoreview:6550. The ACP documentation explicitly illustrates a text message before a tool call: [Prompt Turn](https://agentclientprotocol.com/protocol/v1/prompt-turn). A written JSON review following that progress text can also be rejected as non-JSON. Separately, the live contract test at tests/test_antigravity_live.py:156 accepts a server-side permission failure reported as a tool update instead of a permission request. That path never sets refused_tool, so an empty turn after it still reaches Autoreview as empty output.
findings.title: Not done: A refused Antigravity review can finish without identifying the refused step

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - A review of authentication code refuses a command titled "Inspect rate limit configuration".
The new refusal includes the model-authored tool title in the error. The retry loop at src/forge/review.py:1006 searches the entire error for "rate limit", and at :1010 retries without incrementing its attempt counter. It therefore waits and starts another paid review even though the provider was not rate-limited; repeated similar refusals keep close retrying instead of stopping with the refused step.
findings.title: Stop treating refused tool titles as provider rate limits

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - Antigravity returns usage with an empty review after a tool is refused.
The new refusal raises after the usage has been read but before review_engine can save it. Its exception path at src/forge/antigravity.py:226 exits before the session and token record at :235; src/forge/review.py:1003 consequently records no conversation or usage for either failed attempt. Before this change, the empty end-turn reached that record-writing code. Forge loses the information needed to attribute the review's cost and find its conversation for investigation.
Adds work: preserve returned usage and conversation metadata on refused reviews; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 2.
findings.title: Preserve failed review usage and conversation records

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - Neon writes a review containing a blocking finding after a refused tool call.
Done when: An Antigravity review whose tool call is refused either returns Neon's written review or stops with a message that names the refused step, never "empty output".
The positive case supplies a clean report with an empty findings list and asserts only a successful exit. An implementation that drops every finding after a refusal would still pass. The stub at tests/stubs/agy:88 also sends no progress text before the refusal, so the test passes with the non-JSON failure described above. Exercise the written finding and the progress-before-refusal case through close and assert their observable outcomes.
findings.title: Test: Refused Antigravity reviews preserve Neon's written findings

why: Neon's review ends with "review engine returned empty output" because a refused tool call cancels the turn, and the empty answer is accepted as a completed review, so close stops after two tries.
